text: Figure 3.36: Cuboid Memory Representation (COLUMN_DIR) This means that the data is stored in direction of columns and then in direction of rows starting with the ﬁrst slice ([1,1,1],[1,2,1],[1,3,1], ... ,[1,4,5]). The second slice starts with ([2,1,1],[2,2,1],[2,3,1], ... ,[2,4,5]) and follows the same pattern. ARXML representation: The ARXML representation of the record layout Cuboid_s16s16s16_s16 is given in two parts for illustrative reason. The ﬁrst part deﬁnes the number of sampling points and the elements of axis.
